definitions.full: H7955. shalah שָׁלוּ noun feminine neglect, remissness ( ᵑ7 id. ); — absolute ׳שׁ Ezra 4:22 ; 6:9 ; Dan 6:5 + 3:29 Qr; Kt שׁלה usually thought an error for שׁלו ; Hi Bev M (perhaps) explained as שֵׁלָה = שְׁאֵלָה = thing, affair ( 4:14 ).
